summary: Isolate host publication from candidate Python module discovery, constrain orchestration Git configuration, and reject special-file build artifacts before promotion or host consumption.

compatibility.detail: Integrator version 10 invalidates prior publication signatures. Host Git refuses local executable drivers/includes; hooks and fsmonitor are disabled. Candidate output must contain only real directories and regular files.

manual.detail: Launch the trusted integrator with python3 -I as documented; host helpers already enforce isolated Python. Keep orchestration Git metadata free of executable local drivers/includes.

recovery.detail: Failed candidates do not activate; generated artifacts and integration signatures can be rebuilt.
